B1.name: Meteor Bash
B1.description: Ted sends heavy kicks of metal-enhanced moves against opponents, dealing [Earth] damage. The damage dealt becomes [Shield] for self equal to % of its value.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Thrusts several quick fists at the opponent, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Launches spheres of metal towards opponents in a line in a short point range, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams a metal wall in front, dealing % of defense as empowered damage.

S1.name: Metal Barrier
S1.description: Ted creates a large destructible metal barrier in front of him equal to his entire defense for its toughness to shield off incoming attacks in one direction. He then gives [Shield] equal to % of defense to self and allies.

additional.text: If [Invention] is active upon using this skill, instead, give [Shield] equal to an additional % of defense to self and allies and the metal barrier gains twice his defense instead. Clear a stack of [Invention].

S2.name: Rods of Steel
S2.description: Launches a large beam of steel towards opponents, dealing [Earth] empowered damage equal to % of defense. Hit opponents will gain the effect [Dazed].

additional.text: If [Invention] is active, several more beams (+3 more of them) will be shot out, dealing the same damage. Clear a stack of [Invention].

U1.name: Metal Mode
U1.description: Ted will encase metal armor around himself to gain extra defense and outward fighting power, lasting for 16 seconds.

additional.text: Upon activation, Ted will gain +100% movement speed and +20% damage reduction.
Model A: Charge forward and deal [Earth] super empowered damage equal to % of defense to any opponent in his path. Any skills used in conjunction with this Ultimate’s effect will deal +% more damage.

Model B: If off-field, the metal armor will dissipate and form into 2 hovering robotic turret drones that will blast energy pulses towards nearby opponents, dealing % of defense as [Earth] damage per blast.

If two or more stacks of [Invention] are active, instead, gain +50% damage reduction, +150% movement speed, and +50% skill damage for Model A. Summon an extra drone for Model B. Clear all stacks of [Invention].

T1.name: Ultimate Arsenal
T1.description: Ability: Upon using this skill, various effects will activate upon having varying stacks of [Invention]:

additional.text: 1 stack, gain the effect [Gamer]. 2 stacks, gain the effect [Tinkering]. 3+ stacks, turn into Special Skill: Hoverboard which may be used anytime. Stacks do not get consumed when counting and using this skill.

Special Skill: Hoverboard - Ted jumps onto a hoverboard, hovers in the air for a moment with short invulnerability, and crashes his way through his opponents, dealing 325% of attack and 225% of defense as [Fire] and [Earth] AoE damage. The damage scales by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill.
Resonance: No additional effects. Exclusive to Ted.

Dupes.description: For every opponent hit, Ted will gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] which lasts indefinitely. He inflicts [Attack Down I] on nearby opponents every 5 stacks gained.

additional.text: Each stack of [Let'm Cook] will increase defense by +0.25%.
Ted’s Technical Skill effects will also be applied to the party for the same duration.

Gain a [Super Shield] for self equal to 150% of defense after using any Special Skills, the effect is shared amongst the party. Whenever the Dash Skill is used, gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] (Cooldown: 2 seconds).
The inflicted debuff [Attack Down I] is enhanced to [Attack Down III] and an additional debuff [Crit Down II] is inflicted.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

Charge energy gauge by +10% per stack of [Invention] gained. When Ultimate Skill: Metal Mode is used, each stack of [Invention] present before being cleared will increase Ted’s overall damage by an additional +30% per stack for the duration of the Ultimate.

Rapidly consuming all Dash Skills will automatically give Ted the effect [Gamer] and [Tinkering]. These effects are considered effects from a Technical Skill. Whenever either of these effects end, Ted’s Special Skill cooldowns will reset and he gains 2 stacks of [Invention].
